name: Rahab
overview: Rahab, also called Rachab, is introduced in Joshua 2 as a woman who aided the Israelite spies by hiding them from the king of Jericho, demonstrating faith and kindness. Because of her protection of the spies, she and her household were spared when Jericho was destroyed, as recorded in Joshua 6. Her faith is commended in Scripture, and she is notably included in the lineage of Joseph of Nazareth, highlighting her significant role in God's redemptive plan. Additionally, the name Rahab serves symbolically as a term applied to Egypt.
